text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a small refresh of the 'runstart' hello app quickstart. Goal: simplify auth to a single SDK token flow, and make the first deploy a 1-command experience. Want to align snippets and avoid the old multi-step curl examples.
jin: Do we still need the long env-var section? can we default to REDWOOD_API_KEY and show an SDK example first?
maria: yeah, default to REDWOOD_API_KEY. Proposed minimal snippet for Node:

```js
// install: npm i @redwood/inference
const {Client} = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-1', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```

sam: heads-up — the sample-app's Dockerfile uses Node 18 which breaks in CI because of a deprecated dependency (global fetch polyfill). we should either pin to 16 or update the code. i'll open a tiny fix PR unless you prefer pin.
kev: Also can we add a short note about region defaults? customers get confused when they hit higher latencies if they don't set region. maybe a single line under config.
docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — runstart quickstart revamp (maria) :rocket:
maria: thanks — I'll take the PR. @sam can you add the Docker/Node note into the sample-app section? @jin can you sanity-check the auth wording (service token vs api key)?
sam: yep, will add a one-line note and pin the Dockerfile to node:16-alpine in the sample.
jin: LGTM on auth wording. tiny suggestion: prefer "service token" for the example text and keep parentheses for "API key" so it's clear: Service token (API key).
maria: good call. i'll update the snippet and the prose. staging preview available here: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/runstart — check the "Deploy in one command" flow.
kev: :thumbsup: will review after lunch.
maria: merging once CI passes and sample-app build is green. if anyone sees anything blocking before merge ping me here. :eyes:
